name: Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Not published by the brand or its listings
summary: Vietnamese cà phê sữa sold as a vanilla latte: Da Lat and Colombian arabica extracted at 80°C over non-dairy creamer and milk powders, aseptically filled so it keeps without preservatives. King Coffee sells it direct in the US at $19.99 for six 8.04 oz cans, but publishes no nutrition panel, so those columns stay blank until we check a can.
